items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: another thing that helped influence me, helped me to make up our mind, Lonnie Johnson

ctx.x: -- and who else? Ted Weems. Ted Weems had a good swing band during those days and we listened to all the bands, white and black. If they did something we liked, we did it. Then, as I say, we'd learn it, you know, like off the record and we'd play it for our band. One time -- another thing that helped influence me, helped me to make up our mind, Lonnie Johnson -- I know you know the name -- he'd been big many, many times up and down, up and down, he was an amazing man. I've seen Lonnie -- I want to say this before…

So he came to McKinney, Texas, which is between -- halfway between Sherman and Dallas and when one of his records was riding high to play in my auntie's ballroom, which we had never played for her, you know. Heavier names had played for her than we were, you know. So the band didn't show. About 6:00 -- he came early that afternoon and the band, about 6:30, 7:00, no band.
